items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: so I got Don Byas, Billy Taylor piano, Tiny Grimes.

ctx.x: 53rd and Broadway and 51st and Sixth Avenue, took me about five minutes to walk over there, altogether it

was about 20 minutes, I could get over there, get in the uniform, do the two numbers and back. And so there, see, I was doing two Broadway shows at the same time. Two Broadway shows, and they were good shows because my name was on the playbill of each, see, and so I did two Broadway shows right at the same time and that's, I'm the one that replaced Benny. I did that for about four months and what I did I got men right off 52nd Street who were working on 52nd Street to do it, because all they had to do was come…
